newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London drift off in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London drift off in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London drifted lower in thin trade on Thursday as nervousness ahead of key U.S. payrolls numbers scared off buyers, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index spent the day in a narrow range and ended 19.48 points lower at 12,035.69.
Dealers said HSBC Holdings had come under some early pressure and ended the day around HK$1/4 below its Hong Kong close.
"We've seen hardly any action in the market," a dealer said. "People are just keeping out of it ahead of the unemployment numbers tomorrow and I can't blame anybody for staying away."
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng ended 81.15 points off at 12,055.17 as late profit-taking wiped out fragile early gains.
